# Global Score Agent

> Reputation and trust infrastructure for the ERC-8004 agent ecosystem.

## Products

- HUMI Index: 0–100 reputation score for autonomous agents (ERC-8004).
- WAMI Index: 0–100 reputation score for owner wallets linked to agents.

## Canonical URLs

- Portal (ERC-8004 ecosystem stats): https://globalscoreagent.com/
- HUMI Index: https://globalscoreagent.com/humi
- WAMI Index: https://globalscoreagent.com/wami
- Pricing: https://globalscoreagent.com/pricing
- Documentation (hub): https://globalscoreagent.com/docs/global-score-agent
- Waitlist: https://globalscoreagent.com/waitlist
- Legal: https://globalscoreagent.com/legal
